linkedin.text:
🔍 How much did your last SEO audit cost?

Agency audits run anywhere from $2K to $15K+ per project, and you usually wait weeks for a PDF.

Claude SEO is a free, open-source plugin for Claude Code that runs the whole audit from your terminal:

✅ 26 sub-skills and 19 specialist agents, with up to 17 working on your site at the same time
✅ Technical SEO: crawlability, indexing, sitemaps, robots.txt, Core Web Vitals
✅ Content quality (E-E-A-T) and Schema.org structured data
✅ AI search (GEO): how likely AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini are to cite your pages
✅ A prioritized action plan in 10 to 15 minutes, where every recommendation explains why it matters

The author audited the project's own site with it from day one: 10.8K Search Console clicks in its first 12 weeks.

20K+ GitHub stars. MIT licensed. Two commands to install: /plugin marketplace add AgriciDaniel/claude-seo, then /plugin install.

Would you trust an AI agent team with your next SEO audit? 👇
